issue_context.summary: A Canvas FancyZones layout changes zone geometry when the same monitor switches resolution, but the report does not specify the before/after resolutions, DPI scaling, or whether fixed pixels versus proportional scaling is desired.
known_information: The issue concerns a Canvas layout on one physical monitor.
FancyZones changes zone size/position after a screen-size change.

issue_context.analysis: A bug fix could break users who expect Canvas zones to scale with the work area. Exact geometry and expected coordinate semantics are the decision-making evidence.

information_gaps.information: The exact original and changed resolutions, Windows scaling percentages, monitor count/order, and whether the work area changed because of taskbar placement.
information_gaps.why_needed: These values determine whether FancyZones scaled correctly, selected a different work area, or lost monitor identity.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with before/after resolution and scaling for each monitor and note any docking/undocking or taskbar change.

information_gaps.information: Whether Canvas zones should retain absolute pixel coordinates, preserve their proportions, or restore a separate saved layout per resolution.
information_gaps.why_needed: Each expectation requires a different product behavior and migration rule.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Describe the desired coordinates for one example zone before and after the resolution change, preferably with two screenshots.

comment.body:
Thanks for confirming that this uses a Canvas layout. To distinguish a layout-scaling defect from a request for fixed coordinates, could you please provide:
- The exact before/after resolution and Windows scaling percentage for the monitor, plus any other connected monitors, docking change, or taskbar change.
- One example zone’s position/size before and after the change (screenshots are fine).
- Which behavior you expect: fixed pixel coordinates, proportional scaling, or a separately remembered Canvas layout for each resolution.
Please also confirm whether the same behavior still occurs on a current PowerToys release.

title: Change screen size for the same monitor
